test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep alive policy for function arguments to prevent premature object deletion
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep alive policy for return values to ensure child objects survive
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection behavior with circular references and keep alive policies in pybind11
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep alive policy on constructors to verify child objects are retained by parent
test_call_guard: test pybind11 call guard policies including GIL handling and multiple guard ordering
